"""Verify exact copies,source integrity,matched recipe,tables and native pixels."""

import numpy as np
import torch
from PIL import Image
from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail
from spread_matching_offsets import initialize_spread_offsets

from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V174-spread-matching-v1'
output=repo/'docs/results/v174-spread-matching-publication-verification-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
index=repo/'docs/results/v174-spread-matching-final-v1.json';final=read(index);plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
for k in ['preparation','CPU_readiness','postprocess_preparation','baseline_offset_probe','initial_loss_isolation','sources','figures','report']:assert ref(final[k]['path'])==final[k]
for copies in final['copies'].values():
 for b in copies.values():assert ref(b['path'])==b
 assert Path(copies['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copies['public']['path']).read_bytes()
prep=read(final['preparation']['path']);sources=read(final['sources']['path']);ready=read(final['CPU_readiness']['path']);post=read(final['postprocess_preparation']['path']);source_checks=0
for s in prep['source_texts']+sources['additional_sources']+post['source_texts']:
 assert ref(s['path'])['sha256']==s['sha256'] and Path(s['path']).read_text()==s['text'];source_checks+=1
for name,h in plan['prior_neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256']==h
assert len(plan['prior_neural_hashes'])==96
assert '133 passed' in ready['CPU_tests']['text'] and ready['metric_runtime']['contents']['new_neural_forwards']==0
assert ref(ready['runner']['path'])==ready['runner']==plan['runner'] and ref(ready['renderer']['path'])==ready['renderer']
def functions(p):return {n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.parse(p.read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
reference=read(plan['matched_V172_recipe']['reference_plan']['path']);old=Path(reference['runner']['path']);current=Path(plan['runner']['path']);a,b=functions(old),functions(current)
assert all(a[k]==b[k] for k in ['train','runtime','resources','tree_equal'])
assert ref(plan['matched_V172_recipe']['objective']['path'])['sha256']==ref(repo/'scripts/nonlocal_residual_objective.py')['sha256']
assert ref(plan['offset_initializer']['path'])['sha256']==ref(repo/'scripts/spread_matching_offsets.py')['sha256']
control=LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan['module_config']).load_frozen_component(plan['frozen_component']['export']['path']);original_state={k:v.clone() for k,v in control.state_dict().items()};assert model_hash(control)==plan['matched_V172_recipe']['old_initial_module_hash']
changed=initialize_spread_offsets(control,spacing=8);differences=[k for k,v in control.state_dict().items() if not torch.equal(v,original_state[k])];assert differences==plan['matched_V172_recipe']['changed_initial_tensors']==['network.'+n for n in changed] and len(differences)==5
assert sum(int((control.state_dict()[k]!=original_state[k]).sum()) for k in differences)==60 and model_hash(control)==plan['matched_V172_recipe']['new_initial_module_hash']
assert 'method = f"V174-{endpoint}"' in current.read_text() and plan['methods']==['V174-raw','V174-EMA']
for endpoint,binding in final['checkpoints'].items():
 assert ref(binding['export']['path'])==binding['export'];state=torch.load(binding['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 module=LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**state['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['state_dict'],strict=True)
 assert state['component']=='LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail' and model_hash(module)==binding['module_hash'] and model_hash(module.frozen)==binding['frozen_module_hash']
 assert len(module.state_dict())==188 and len(module.network.state_dict())==141 and sum(p.numel() for p in module.network.parameters())==2088906
 assert state['matched_V172_recipe']==plan['matched_V172_recipe'] and ref(state['source']['path'])==state['source']
paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');summary={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']};bindings=read(root/'report-bindings-v1.json');report=repo/'docs/spread-sample-matching.md';text=report.read_text();assert ref(report)==bindings['report']==final['report']
for cell in bindings['cells']:
 s=summary[cell['kind'],cell['condition'],cell['cohort'],cell['method']];assert f"{s[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}"==cell['rendered']
for line in bindings['lines']:assert line in text
native=read(final['figures']['path']);assert len(native['images'])==60 and sum(i['triplet'] for i in native['images'])==12
prior=read(plan['prior_figures']['path']);old_map={i['image']['path']:i for i in prior['images']};new_channels=copied_channels=0
for item in native['images']:
 old=old_map[item['source_figure']['path']]
 assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image'] and item['source_figure']==old['image'] and item['no_resize']
 assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['original_image']['path']).read_bytes()
 for field in ['ROI_xywh','anchor','contrast','exposure']:assert item[field]==old[field]
 image=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));old_image=np.asarray(Image.open(old['image']['path']));a=dict(np.load(item['case']['arrays']['path']));anchor=np.asarray(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1);old_panels={p['label']:p for p in old['panels']}
 for panel in item['panels']:
  label=panel['label'];x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160
  if label in item['predictions']:
   binding=item['predictions'][label];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;value=np.load(binding['path']);expected=independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure']);new_channels+=expected.size
  else:
   p=old_panels[label];ox,oy,ow,oh=p['xywh'];expected=old_image[oy:oy+oh,ox:ox+ow];copied_channels+=expected.size
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected)
view=read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json');assert view['native_figures']==60 and sorted(view['indices'])==list(range(60)) and ref(view['journal']['path'])==view['journal']
e=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');assert e['quality_wrapper_calls']==1644 and e['repeated_scientific_prefix_calls']==0 and e['total_new_candidate_matching_CUDA_calls']==2404 and e['total_new_matching_CUDA_calls']==2410
training=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json');assert training['cached_batches_checked']==1000 and training['final_Adam_states']==141 and training['strict_final_raw_and_EMA_states']==2
quality=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json');assert quality['input_fingerprints_checked']==6576 and quality['saved_native_RGB_checked']==quality['saved_native_residuals_checked']==72 and quality['ADC_outputs_exact_V169']==144
offsets=read(root/'offset-audit-v1.json');assert offsets['arrays']==30 and offsets['bytes']==102780672
for observation in offsets['observations']:
 for block in observation['blocks']:assert ref(block['array']['path'])==block['array']
assert e['saved_offset_arrays']==30 and e['saved_offset_array_bytes']==102780672
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
diary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();assert diary.is_relative_to(repo/'diary') and diary.is_file()
documents=[repo/p for p in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/spread-sample-matching.md']]+[diary];links=0
for p in documents:
 for target in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):continue
  resolved=(p.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert resolved==output or resolved.is_file(),(p,target);links+=1
save(output,dict(status='pass-exact-copies-sources-matched-recipe-endpoints-tables-native-pixels-and-links',publication=ref(index),exact_copies=len(final['copies']),source_texts_checked=source_checks,unchanged_prior_neural_files=96,strict_full_state_endpoint_loads=2,matched_function_ASTs=4,strict_initial_changed_bias_vectors=5,strict_initial_changed_scalars=60,other183_initial_tensors_exact=True,saved_offset_tensors_checked=30,rounded_table_cells=len(bindings['cells']),native_figures=60,native_triplets=12,new_RGB_channels_recomputed=new_channels,unchanged_RGB_channels_compared=copied_channels,document_links_checked=links,documents={str(p):ref(p) for p in documents},new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope=quality['scope']))
print('PASS',len(final['copies']),'exact copies;',source_checks,'source texts;',len(bindings['cells']),'cells;60 native figures;',new_channels+copied_channels,'RGB channels;',links,'links')
